Stock closure / Wine SDK experiment

Base: interop f8fe8a3d3fd83bad0c2285d31aa18374015119e7.
Feature ref only: ci/proton-stock-reuse-20261108. Candidate/default refs are
unchanged. Default stock_mode=off retains the ordinary complete build path.
Piper prefetch/verification and the run_attempt compiler-cache suffix remain.

Review contract (coordinator1611ada1, before any experimental run):
- Complete pre-prefix stock closure and portable SDK are byte/type/mode/link
  identical between cold export and verified warm import.
- Every final installed executable (including scripts), PE and DSO must match
  byte for byte. Prefix stub binaries receive no exemption.
- Inventory ALL installed file/type/mode/link differences, without editing or
  normalizing any payload. Only these advance-named classes are eligible:
  (a) version's date +%s field, generated by Makefile.in all-dist;
  (b) default_pfx Wineboot registry timestamps or host-dependent state, generated
      by default_pfx.py make_default_pfx -> Wine wineboot, then filter_registry.
      B verified two additional Wineboot outputs across four production builds:
      same-type/mode default_pfx/.update-timestamp changes, and exactly one
      four-hex Installer MSI filename rename per prefix with equal sha/size/mode.
      Those also need B review; retain exact timestamp bytes and MSI content.
      More than one MSI in that directory, changed content/size/mode/type,
      unexpected filenames/locations or any executable delta remain FAIL.
  All differences outside those classes FAIL. Registry path membership alone
  does not classify its contents: raw unified diffs/auxiliary bytes are retained and B must
  classify EVERY delta as timestamp/host state, otherwise FAIL.
- Comparison returns NEEDS_REGISTRY_REVIEW, never equivalence PASS, for registry
  differences (including the timestamp and strict MSI rename). A green warm CI means tests ran and no known-forbidden difference
  occurred; it is NOT a finished qualification/admission when that status remains.
- Final-prefix/version determinism is a separate follow-up. No third baseline
  build, no retries/cancellations, no extra Deck/game run for timing.

Cold mode builds all stock components through the existing rules, omitting only
candidate native/bridge and prefix generation in that phase. It prepares the
normal strong-provider Wine ABI SDK, exports installed stock + portable SDK +
reviewed Wine ABI/stub sources and both raw Wine stubs, then performs candidate
native/bridge/redist assembly and the existing full test set. Both proof arms
use the same portable SDK/source/raw-stub roots at the same absolute paths.
After cold stock compilation, its full source/raw-install roots are replaced by
exact portable exports; full tree equality rejects additional headers/files in
those roots as well as any changed bytes, modes, symlink targets or types. No Wine object tree, Cargo
target or completion stamp is exported. version and LICENSE are assembly inputs,
regenerated for the current candidate rather than imported as stock provenance.

Warm mode requires explicit cold run ID, artifact ID, artifact ZIP SHA256 and
producer SHA. The cold run must be green attempt1 on this feature ref/workflow.
Download verifies run/head/name/digest/size and an exact regular-file ZIP set.
Container import verifies inner archive digest, complete source/toolchain input
identity and manifest bytes/type/mode/link coverage BEFORE populating an empty
build directory. SDK ABI/source/raw-stub checks precede bridge use. Native and
bridge outputs are built afresh; prefix/default manifests/licenses are generated
normally. No arbitrary .wine-* stamps are synthesized to suppress prerequisites.

Keyed inputs include all tracked root blobs, static recursive gitlinks and their
actual tracked deltas (the reviewed Piper mutation included), dependency git
describe strings, SDK digest, underlying compiler/tool hashes, package inventory,
fixed paths, epochs and configuration. Only native/backend and bridge gitlink
subtrees are excluded from stock identity. Other candidate changes conservatively
invalidate the stock closure. Imported make mode refuses unsupported flags,
epochs, target, tool identity and parallelism. ABI SDK contents are checked again
before use and after tests. A changed SDK, extra SDK header or raw stub is fatal.

The first proof is SAME producer/source/pins in both arms. Component identity
supports later pin-only changes, but this workflow's warm qualification compares
all final binaries with its seed and will fail deliberate candidate binary changes.
Production changed-pin consumption/rollout needs separately reviewed orchestration
and candidate qualification; this experiment does not grant automatic admission.

All existing tests remain: source policy, patch reapplication, Piper fixtures,
native backend parser/PTX CPU tests via ZLUDA_RUN_PTX_TESTS=1, bridge native unit
tests, complete-tool smoke, installed Proton Session/launcher smoke, and normal
source/license/ABI/stub checks. Added fixtures cover import/export, unsafe archives,
source binding, SDK drift, artifact selection and strict comparison. Make graph
fixtures may skip on a local controller without make. In GITHUB_ACTIONS,
absence of make is fatal instead of skipped, and the precheck records make
--version before the graph tests. CI must pass both graph fixtures before build.
Compiler/Cargo caches remain enabled as before: total observed speed includes
their effects. Stock/native phase markers and before/after ccache statistics
allow those effects to be distinguished in the report, rather than attributing
the entire time change to component reuse.

Resource/permissions: unchanged3CPU/10G build,3CPU/6G test and350min timeout;
existing initial48GiB disk floor retained. Export checks additional stage/archive
headroom; download checks ZIP headroom. Imported payload cap8GiB. Artifact read
requires newly declared job actions:read; contents:read unchanged, no new secrets
or package-write permission. Seed publishes ONLY after all tests and postchecks
pass; proof metadata remains on failure. Artifacts retain14days; absence/expiry
fails closed. No 'latest', wildcard cache or foreign/PR seed is selected.

Before publication/dispatch: B reviews this contract and exact source/YAML diff;
coordinator binds the concrete producer SHA/cloud clearance. The permitted future
experiment is ONE cold, then ONE warm only after green cold and pinned seed proof,
same unchanged pin/configuration, no retries. No cloud run is triggered by this
document or by a local commit. New feature ref does not match push build filters.

Adoption evidence (no third build): compare the future cold qualification with
B-pinned production f8fe8a3d TOOL-TREE.json SHA256
1b1ca436aaf7037e229720408179f56dd9d163ad83974da9902f8e804b466a1f.
The controller compare-production.py projects type/sha/bytes/mode/link target,
drops only the dot root and mtime_ns representation field, and reports EVERY
difference without exemption. It does not edit files or approve adoption. The
source inventory is read-only; a byte-verified copy is bound in the review packet.
